label: LLM Tool
description: Declare one tool the model may call: a name, what it does, and a JSON Schema for its arguments. Its `tool` goes wherever an LlmTool goes: into the List feeding an LLM node's `tools`, or onto a Dispatch branch. A tool written as a group usually declares this on a `*tool` metadata port instead; this node is for one built while the program runs. The model's calls come out on the LLM node's toolCalls output, and a Chat Message (role tool) feeds each result back.

inputs.name: description
inputs.label: Description
inputs.placeholder: Get the current weather for a city
inputs.description: What the tool does, written for the model: this is how it decides when to call it.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.label: Arguments schema
inputs.description: JSON Schema for the tool's arguments, as an object. Leave empty for a tool that takes none.

outputs.name: tool
outputs.description: The tool, for a List feeding an LLM node's `tools`, or anywhere an LlmTool goes.
